text:
katie_pm: RCA published for yesterday's model-router split-brain during canary. Short summary: a small percentage of requests were routed to stale weights causing a ~5% error spike for ~9m. RCA link: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2467890123-model-router-splitbrain

katie_pm: High-level impact: customer-facing latencies up for a subset of routes, degraded LLM responses for ~2k requests. No data exfiltration.

katie_pm: Key action items (owners):
• dev: add rollout guard + stronger router healthcheck (devon_eng)
• infra: automated canary rollback on divergence (ira_sre)
• runtime: KV cache invalidation on model swap (sam)
• ops: add routing-divergence alerting + dashboard (alex)

katie_pm: 7-day checkpoint Thu 10:00 PT, 30-day review scheduled. Owners please ack and add ETA/PR links in the doc.

devon_eng: ack — I will draft the healthcheck spec and a small e2e test by EOD.

ira_sre: ack. I'll add the rollback runbook and a playbook note for on-call. ETA Tue COB.

sam: investigating KV cache edge-case, suspect race during model swap. Will open a PR with fix + test by Wed.

alex: I'll provision extra canary traffic for the next 48h and surface metrics to the RCA doc.

ops-bot: RCA document published by katie_pm — link: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2467890123-model-router-splitbrain

katie_pm: thanks all :heart: tagging @product and @support for alignment on external comms. Please do not post externally until comms draft is approved.

devon_eng: quick reproduction steps added under 'testcase' in the doc. Example command:
```
# reproduce locally
./scripts/run_canary.sh --seed=42 --routes=2
```

ira_sre: adding monitoring alert: routing_divergence > 1% for 5m. Will attach alert runbook.

sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/runtime/pull/412 — adds atomic KV invalidation on model swap. Marked as high-priority.

alex: metrics dashboard link added in RCA. Will post a follow-up snapshot at the 24h mark.

katie_pm: noted. Closing this thread for now — we'll reconvene at the 7-day checkpoint. If anything slips, ping me directly.
